decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) a sharp multi-sample shift in N/E around indices 618–622, possibly a step or rapid motion; (2) a sustained large-magnitude displacement starting near index 690, forming a persistent platform across all axes. Both show clear morphological deviations from surrounding noise-like variability.

regions.observation: Abrupt multi-sample drop in N and E (N from ~-10 to ~-12.5, E from ~3 to ~1) around index 618–622, followed by sustained low-N/E platform; U shows less coherent change but remains elevated. The transition is sharp and spans several samples, suggesting a possible permanent offset or rapid motion event.

Sustained large-amplitude displacement in N/E/U beginning near index 690: N drops sharply to ~-12.5, E becomes strongly negative (~-10 to -13), U rises to ~2–5. This persists through the end of the record with minor fluctuations, indicating a prolonged platform or drift phase rather than transient noise.
